subject: SLA packaging questions and proposed response-ladder / volume credits
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SLA and premium support pricing questions

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week — Nimbus is excited about Redwood's latency and cost controls. Before our procurement review on June 1, my team needs a clearer picture of the premium support packaging. Two quick items:

1) Uptime tiers and associated credits — can you confirm whether credits are proration-based by minute or applied as monthly bill credits?

2) Response-ladder: we need 24/7 triage for P1/P2, and an escalation runway to a named technical owner at Redwood for P1 within 2 hours. What does Redwood charge for a 24/7 escalation layer vs. standard business-hours coverage?

If you have a standard playbook or an options matrix (tiers + pricing + sample credits), please send. I've attached our projected monthly token utilization for Q3 to help size this.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Head of Procurement — Nimbus Analytics
elena.torres@nimbus.ai

Attachment: nimbus_usage_profile_q1-q2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 98 KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support pricing questions

Elena — thanks for the clear list and the usage file. Attaching our SLA playbook and a short matrix that maps uptime bands to credit formulas and response-ladders. High level answers:

- Credits: we apply credits as monthly invoice adjustments (percentage of monthly invoice tied to the affected model route). We also offer a minute-level SLA audit (for high-commit customers) which generates a detailed report and supporting evidence.

- Response-ladder: our standard "Priority Lane" (business hours) includes 2-hour initial response for P1 and named on-call for critical incidents during BH. For 24/7 escalation we offer "Round-the-Clock Priority" which guarantees a named escalation owner and a target acknowledgement within 30 minutes and a full triage handoff to engineering within 2 hours; pricing is expressed as an uplift on top of the base support SKU.

Proposal attached: 1) redwood_sla_playbook_v1.pdf (matrix + examples), 2) a draft price table with volume bands and a sample 12-month commit discount.

Two asks from my side to speed approvals:
- If Nimbus is willing to commit to a 12-month minimum usage band and a 3x average daily token commit, we can provide a blended discount and a 24/7 escalation add-on discount.
- If you need a hard SLA credit cadence by minute for audit, we can scope a SOC2-ready audit addendum (extra 3 weeks).

Let me know if you want to hop on a quick call tomorrow to walk through the playbook.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_sla_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 430 KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SLA and premium support pricing questions — Nimbus (prep for pricing approval)

Team — forwarding Nimbus's ask and the draft playbook I just sent. Key negotiation levers they care about: 24/7 escalation owner, minute-level credit reporting, and a meaningful commit for 12 months.

Quick take:
- Margin: base support SKU already prices for ~35% gross margin. If we extend 24/7 escalation at standard uplift (x1.5), margin drops to ~22% before factoring in onboarding effort.
- Discount levers: multi-month commit + tiered volume bands + a small commit guarantee (3x daily) would get us to acceptable blended economics.

Suggested approval path:
1) Authorize a one-time commercial discount up to 12% off list if Nimbus signs a 12-month commit (deal_id RDF-2391).
2) Approve a 10% discount on the 24/7 escalation add-on as a concession for the commit.
3) Require finance sign-off if combined discount > 15%.

Can you confirm quickly? I'll present the positioned offer if we have consensus.

— Kimberly

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@nimbus.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support pricing questions

Kimberly — reviewed your playbook with our ops and procurement. Appreciate the clarity. A couple of counterpoints from our side:

- Nimbus can commit to a 12-month term and accelerate to a 3x daily token commit if Redwood will extend a 15% discount on the overall support + escalation bundle (this includes the 24/7 escalation layer).
- For auditability, we need minute-granular crediting or exportable SLA reports for 6 months. If you cannot change the crediting mechanism, we would accept a $X/month premium for an audit report (please propose a number).

If you can accept the 15% blended discount in the proposal and provide the report export for 6 months, we can finalize procurement paperwork next week and route to legal.

Thanks,
Elena

Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 14:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SLA and premium support pricing questions — final positioned offer

Elena,

Thanks — we can accept Nimbus's 12-month commit and provide a blended 15% discount on the combined support + 24/7 escalation bundle under the following conditions:

1) Commit: 12-month minimum with a 3x average daily token commit (the attached usage file matches the sizing).
2) Reporting: we will provide minute-granular SLA event exports for the prior 6 months via a secure S3 share (we'll redact sensitive tokens). This will be delivered as part of the support onboarding.
3) Audit addendum: if you require external third-party attestation of minute-level crediting, we'll scope a SOC2 audit addendum for an additional fee; otherwise the S3 exports + internal audit report will be provided at no extra charge.
4) Contracting: we will include a cap on total monthly credits equal to 25% of the monthly support invoice for major incidents; smaller credits follow the standard band table in redwood_sla_playbook_v1.pdf.

Next steps: I can generate the commercial summary and a DocuSign link once you confirm acceptance of the above. If accepted by EOD Wednesday, we will honor the 15% blended discount and deliver the report share during onboarding.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/placeholder/RDF-2391-SLA
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/0000/deal/2391

Looking forward —
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
